title: [dev-h] Target raised by autosens sensitivity does not reset when profile is switched
body:
My daughter has been battling a stomach bug since yesterday and been very insulin sensitive. We had a few months ago adjusted the min/max settings for autosens to 0.2-1.7 as her needs were fluctuating a lot while honeymoon was ending. After about 12 hours of no food or drink (with steady glucose), autosens started ticking down, eventually past 50% heading further down. At this point her glucose stayed at 5.5mmol (target was 6.5mmol). What I didn't notice at the time was that her target was raised due to sensitivity, and the lower the sensitivity got, the higher the target. I did notice around 4pm that her basal had been held back to almost 0 for about 4 hours. We started encouraging her to eat and drink very carefully, totaling about 15 carbs worth of apple juice over a couple of hours. glucose started rising but system was still not dosing, so I gave a small bolus via the insulin button to get something in her. Only after a good while did I catch the high target. I tried to reset autosens by doing a profile switch but it only reset the autosens % (and the sens line on the graph), but not the target. Target remained high until I went in the settings and reset min/max for autosens to default values, then was automatically set to 7.8 which I don't quite get how it calculated. 
I've since reinstalled master branch and tried a profile switch there as well, which caused the target to be reset to profile target on next SMB run. 
Installed dev-h again to be able to keep using Dynamic ISF, and target is now back at 7.8, which is honestly fine at this point while she's still not eating. 
Attached are some screenshots to illustrate, and log from around the first profile switch to try and change the target back.
